2707-4872-5497.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Hoverstone Pilgrim by paying {2}, causing you to put Time Warp on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

855-3899-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
855-3899-5254.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat.

2034-4694-6258-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-4694-6258-7306.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Repeat from step 1.

5478-5531-5694-6927-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
5478-5531-5694-6927-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Damage Control Crew and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Damage Control Crew and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Damage Control Crew trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.
5478-5531-5694-6927-8110.notes:
If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Damage Control Crew and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.
An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

2178-3899-5470.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ghired.
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
2178-3899-5470.description:
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature token.
When the token dies, Ghired triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4050-5070.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4050-5070.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

2111-4981-5226.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

4153-4186-5147--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 5.

2440-4613-7132.description:
Activate Super-Skrull's first ability by paying {3}, creating a 0/3 Wall creature token with defender.
When the Wall enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Wall you control.
Repeat.
2440-4613-7132.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use it to activate any of Super-Skrull's abilities.

997-3413-5929.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Leyline of Transformation, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4661-4753.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4661-4753.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Clever Impersonator and Vesuvan Doppelganger each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vesuvan Doppelganger trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4661-4753.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2033-5434-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
2033-5434-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
2033-5434-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1394-2060-6797-7038-7741.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Shang-Chi.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Shang-Chi.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

1495-6919-7704.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Triskelion triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Doc Samson.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
1495-6919-7704.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

560-2457-4289-5434.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1563-3899-4772-5434.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2097-5742-5743-7435.description:
Activate Hardened Academic by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Hardened Academic ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

240-1753-2921-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat from step 2.

372-2187-7339.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Go Ninja Go exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2187-7339.description:
Cast Go Ninja Go by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Possessed Skaab and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Possessed Skaab trigger.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Go Ninja Go from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Go Ninja Go.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Possessed Skaab and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1251-2769-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-2769-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Hanweir Garrison as attackers.
Hanweir Garrison triggers, creating two creature tokens
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-4775-6553.easyPrerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
2034-4775-6553.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Repeat.

1350-2713-6252-6322.description:
Activate Arms Race by paying {1}{R}, putting Boommobile from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boommobile enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}{R} or {W}{W}{W}{W} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {W}, returning Boommobile from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1350-2713-6252-6322.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Boommobile's ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

864-5733-6122.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
864-5733-6122.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Eternal Witness by paying its mana cost.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Eternal Witness from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

3101-4050-5920.manaNeeded: {B/R}{B/R}{B/R}, minus {B/R} for each +1/+1 counter on Runaway Steam-Kin
3101-4050-5920.notablePrerequisites: A non-Zombie creature has died this turn.
3101-4050-5920.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Undead Sprinter, adding {B/R}.
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate it by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Undead Sprinter from your graveyard by paying {B}{R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2558-2921-5123-5687.notablePrerequisites: You control no more than two additional creatures.
2558-2921-5123-5687.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Jetmir, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1479-2232-5362.notablePrerequisites:
An additional nonartifact permanent card in your hand that you are able to play.
An additional nonartifact permanent card on the battlefield that shares a type with the card in your hand and that has an equal or lesser mana cost.
1479-2232-5362.description:
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying {4}{U}, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Kodama of the East Tree and exiling Quantum Misalignment.
When the token enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and the original Kodama of the East Tree trigger; decline to use these abilities unless desired.
Play the nonartifact permanent in your hand.
When it enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and both copies of Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other nonartifact permanent from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the first Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the permanent you returned in step 5 from your hand onto the battlefield.
When that permanent enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and the second Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the permanent you played in step 3 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger from step 7, declining to use it unless desired.
Resolve the remaining Kodama of the East Tree trigger from step 4, putting the permanent you returned in step 8 from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4 any number of times.
This combo results in Infinite ETB and Infinite LTB if a permanent involved is a creature, and/or Infinite landfall triggers if it is a land.

1408-2427-3055-4050.notablePrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Dogmeat.
1408-2427-3055-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dogmeat, adding {W}.
When Dogmeat dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Dogmeat to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Dogmeat enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return Gift of Immortality to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Gift of Immortality by paying {W} due to Mana Matrix, attaching it to Dogmeat.
Repeat.

275-1799-4050-4242.notablePrerequisites: Grenzo has a power of four or greater.
275-1799-4050-4242.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding one mana of any color.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1558-2499-2963-4840.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers twice, creating eight 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Myrs, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1235-4280-4863-5195.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {1}{R}, targeting Revolutionist.
Storm-Kiln Artist and Veyran trigger twice.
Resolve both Veyran triggers, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve both Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve Twinflame, creating a token copy of Revolutionist with haste.
When the Revolutionist token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Twinflame to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.

2480-3556-4074.notablePrerequisites: You have not copied a spell using Chandra's ability this turn.
2480-3556-4074.description:
Activate Chandra's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, adding {1}{W}.
Cast Flicker by paying {1}{W}, targeting Tamiyo.
Chandra triggers, causing you to copy Flicker, with the copy targeting Chandra.
Resolve both Flickers, blinking Chandra and Tamiyo.
Activate Tamiyo's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2781-4050-4577.notablePrerequisites: At least four reprieve counters on Magnanimous Magistrate.
2781-4050-4577.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian, adding {1}.
Magnanimous Magistrate triggers, allowing you to remove four reprieve counters from it and return Felidar Guardian from the graveyard to the battlefield.
Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, blinking Magnanimous Magistrate.
Repeat.

2034-2965-5110-5286.description:
Activate Helm of Kaldra by paying {1}, creating a legendary 4/4 Kaldra token and attaching Helm of Kaldra, Shield of Kaldra, and Sword of Kaldra to it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kaldra, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

3327-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
3327-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dargo, adding {R}.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Repeat.

3106-3490-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional creature token.
3106-3490-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Grismold triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
